prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn api_token_validation(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Trim ASCII spaces, then validate scheme:name:version. Scheme is non-empty lowercase ASCII letters; name is lowercase ASCII letters or digits separated by single interior hyphens; version is canonical unsigned decimal in 0..9223372036854775807. Return the canonical token, otherwise invalid.
Visible example:  auth:user-2:0  returns auth:user-2:0; Auth:user:1 is invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
